Open problem: it is unclear what the screen should do or what is required from it.
Uncertainty about saving the project file (whether it saves automatically and where).
The target group will be sixteen to forty.
The basic new requirements of the management were no teletext, only for T_V_.
Teletext and the newsflash feature will not be used in the future.
Keep all classic remote functions and improve button usability and the physical design.
The product must include corporate identity with the logo present and colours consistent.
The PM will write the meeting minutes.

The UI Designer will compile a list of the functions to be on the LCD screen menu.
The UI Designer will implement a paged LCD menu.
The ID will integrate the channel-changing functionality into the design.
The UI Designer will position the LCD screen on top and separate advanced functions from basic functions.
